description: This file defines the TelemetryWebsocketService class, which extends a WebsocketService to handle telemetry data via WebSocket connections in an Angular application. It manages subscriptions, updates, unsubscriptions, and processes incoming WebSocket messages related to telemetry data, alarms, notifications, and subscriptions.

classes.name: TelemetryWebsocketService
classes.description: An Angular service that manages WebSocket communication for telemetry data, including subscribing, updating, and unsubscribing telemetry data streams, and processing incoming WebSocket messages.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a TelemetrySubscriber to telemetry data streams, assigning command IDs and managing the subscribers map.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing subscriber with new subscription commands, primarily for entity data and unread subscriptions.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes a TelemetrySubscriber, sending appropriate unsubscribe commands for each subscription type and removing the subscriber from the map.

methods.name: processOnMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages, routing them to the appropriate subscriber handlers based on message content and type.
